items.name: Bolivia Nationals 2026
items.information:
🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2026!** 🟥🟨🟩

Este campeonato celebra los 10 años desde que Bolivia organizó su primer Campeonato Nacional, un evento que dio inicio al crecimiento del speedcubing en nuestro país. Desde entonces, nuestra comunidad no ha dejado de crecer, reuniendo a personas de todas las edades y de diferentes regiones, unidas por la pasión por el Speedcubing, el desafío de superar sus propios tiempos y el de compañerismo que caracteriza a la comunidad del speedcubing.

Hoy queremos celebrar todo ese camino recorrido con una edición muy especial.

La inscripción está abierta para todos, sin importar la edad ni el lugar de donde vengan. ¡Anímate a ser parte de esta celebración y vive un campeonato que quedará en la historia del speedcubing en Bolivia!


 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2026!**   🟥🟨🟩
His championship celebrates 10 years since Bolivia hosted its very first National Championship, the event that helped kick off the growth of speedcubing in our country. Since then, our community has kept growing, bringing together people of all ages and from all over the country who share a passion for the Speedcubing, chasing new personal bests, and the amazing sense of community that makes speedcubing so special.

We're excited to celebrate this journey with a very special edition of the championship.

Registration is open to everyone, no matter your age or where you're from. Come join us, meet fellow cubers, and be part of a championship that will make speedcubing history in Bolivia!

**🇧🇷 Português (PT-BR)**
A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser feitas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, com pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição só será confirmada após a validação do pagamento.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizar gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e vídeos registrados durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais.

---

**🇺🇸 English (EN-US)**
The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registration must be completed exclusively through the WCA website, with advance payment of the fee via PIX (Brazilian instant payment system). Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation.

By registering, you authorize AACM, the WCA, and their partners to use your image free of charge in photos and videos recorded during the event, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Dutch Nationals 2026
items.information:
Dit is het officiële Nederlandse Kampioenschap. 

De wedstrijd staat open voor kubussers met alle nationaliteiten. Alleen Nederlandse deelnemers kunnen prijzen en titels winnen. 

Voor finales (behalve gecombineerde) gaat **top 14** door. Dit is top 14 Nederlanders. Iedereen die sneller is dan de 14e Nederlander gaat ook nog door.

Gasten zijn welkom.
_____
This is the official Dutch Championship. 

The competition is open to cubers from all countries. Only Dutch competitors can win prizes and awards. 

For finals (except combined finals) the **top 14** will advance. This means top 14 Dutch. Everyone that is faster than the 14th Dutch will also advance. 

Guests are welcome.

items.name: Etna Open 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjM1MzkyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--29e10ee44684e4c5505ecd1562faf1428f8ea644/Etna%20Open%202026_.png)

![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png)

Benvenuti all'**Etna Open 2026**! La competizione si svolge in occasione del decimo anniversario della prima competizione siciliana.

* **Iscrizioni solo online** tramite la [sezione Registrati](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EtnaOpen2026/register) del menù di questo sito.
* La competizione prevede tutti gli eventi WCA, ma **non è necessario partecipare a tutti gli eventi o essere presenti tutti e tre i giorni**. Ad esempio, se i tuoi eventi preferiti sono solo la domenica, puoi partecipare solo quel giorno.
* Per gli eventi con almeno due turni, viene usato il formato "[Dual Rounds](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9v5)": non ci sono eliminazioni tra il primo e il secondo turno e tutti gli iscritti partecipano a entrambi i turni.

---

![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png)

Welcome to **Etna Open 2026**! The competition marks the tenth anniversary of the first Sicilian competition.

* **Registration is online only**, via the [Register section](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EtnaOpen2026/register) in the menu of this website.
* The competition includes all WCA events, but **you do not need to participate in every event or be present for all three days**. For example, if your preferred events take place only on Sunday, you can choose to attend just that day.
* For events with at least two rounds, a "[Dual Rounds](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9v5)" format will be used: there are no eliminations between the first and second rounds, and all registered competitors will participate in both.
